description: This PHP source file defines the HtmlResponseBigPipeSubscriber class, which subscribes to Symfony kernel response events to replace HtmlResponse objects with BigPipeResponse objects, adding markers and handling placeholders for Drupal's BigPipe rendering strategy.

classes.name: HtmlResponseBigPipeSubscriber
classes.description: A Drupal event subscriber that intercepts HTTP responses to replace HtmlResponse objects with BigPipeResponse objects, managing placeholders and markers for Drupal's BigPipe rendering strategy.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects the BigPipe service.

methods.name: onRespondEarly
methods.description: Adds markers around the scripts_bottom placeholder in the response content if present.

methods.name: onRespond
methods.description: Transforms an HtmlResponse into a BigPipeResponse if necessary, handling placeholders and setting the response accordingly.

methods.name: getBigPipeService
methods.description: Returns the BigPipe service instance used for rendering.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the response event handlers with specific priorities for early and late execution.
